reason: The cleaning log and the cap on kids is exactly what I look for, and I'd probably use the free visit. But $13 a kid plus a sibling, with daycare already eating us, is more than I can spend on a regular basis. Free parks and the library cost nothing.
objection: It adds up fast for two kids when money is tight, and I don't know yet if it's really as clean as they say.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 per child, or a weekday pack that works out to under $9 a visit, after I see the place is actually clean on the free visit.
